summary.headline: Man Infra Q1 FY27 consolidated PAT rose 29% YoY to ₹72 crore on revenue up 8% to ₹218 crore; management reiterates 25%+ FY27 PAT growth guidance.
summary.overview: Management described Q1 FY27 as a strong quarter, citing consolidated revenue from operations of ₹218 crore (+8% YoY) and profit after tax attributable to shareholders of ₹72 crore (+29% YoY). Cash and cash equivalents rose to ₹768 crore at June 2026 from ₹686 crore at FY26-end, with borrowings of ₹78 crore, which management said are mostly partner contributions in joint ventures. Pre-sales in the quarter were about 85,000 sq ft, or roughly ₹290 crore, which management acknowledged is low, attributing the gap to launches that have not yet happened (Marine Lines, Berkeley House). Management kept its FY27 PAT growth guidance of over 25% and its target of ₹5,000 crore cumulative pre-sales over two years, and reiterated a ₹35,000 crore group GDV goal by 2031.

segments.name: Mira-Bhayendar (Aaradhya Parkwood)
segments.commentary: Towers C and D (2 of 4) received occupation certificates in Q1; the project has 1,000 units, ~5.3 lakh sq ft carpet area, ~₹925 crore sales potential, and is 90% sold. Remaining two towers due by end of next year.

segments.name: Vile Parle (Jade Park, DM project)
segments.commentary: Over 60% of inventory sold on ~3.5 lakh sq ft carpet area; near 100% RCC expected by next year. Held under the cluster redevelopment policy and classified as a DM project.

segments.name: Bandra / Pali Hill (Marina Vista, MS collection)
segments.commentary: Launched June 2026 with ~₹500 crore GDV; 30% sold within two months. Artek Park (BKC) is over 25% sold.

segments.name: Mount Mary (Berkeley House)
segments.commentary: IOA received for an ultra-luxury project with over ₹1,000 crore GDV; demolition and vacation of existing structure underway.

segments.name: Mulund West (Atmosphere Tower G, O2 High Street)
segments.commentary: Atmosphere Tower G (~3.2 lakh sq ft carpet) is 75% sold, with delivery targeted by December 2027. O2 High Street is a new commercial launch on the final phase of Atmosphere.

segments.name: Ghatkopar (Aaradhya OnePark)
segments.commentary: ~5.3 lakh sq ft carpet across 11 towers, over 60% sold; structure complete and finishing underway, with delivery targeted by March 2027.

segments.name: Tardeo (Aaradhya Avaan, South Mumbai)
segments.commentary: Over 306 m tall, ~6.5 lakh sq ft carpet, over 60% sold. Half the building (about 32 habitable floors) to be delivered by March 2028 against RERA commitment of December 2030; 40 floors reached so far.

segments.name: Tardeo 2.0 (South Mumbai)
segments.commentary: Acquired project with over ₹2,000 crore GDV; IOA received and launch now targeted within FY27 rather than Q1 FY28.

segments.name: Marine Lines
segments.commentary: Launch targeted by March 2027 after FSI policy change and additional plot acquisitions; over ₹3,000 crore GDV per management, DM structure. Expected to surpass Aavan in height.

segments.name: US (Miami)
segments.commentary: First two villas completed, one sold and one retained as show house for sale around March next year. Third villa targeted at ~$15 million. Ritz-Carlton branded residences presales ~$25 million, completion targeted December 2030. About $35 million transferred so far.

segments.name: EPC
segments.commentary: Management is near final negotiations on a significantly large external EPC order, expected to be announced within two quarters. In-house construction pipeline is ₹9,000-10,000 crore, and a Vadhvan port project is in bidding.

guidance_outlook: FY27 PAT growth guidance of over 25% over FY26 reiterated; management said it sees this as comfortable at the bottom line.
Cumulative pre-sales target of ₹5,000 crore over the next two years reiterated; management said it might exceed this if markets stay strong.
Group GDV target of over ₹35,000 crore by 2031 reiterated, with management expecting it to be achieved earlier.
Management aims for a bottom line near ₹500 crore in roughly 2-3 years; it said a significant jump would start this year.
Launch pipeline of about 1.1 million sq ft carpet and ~₹6,600 crore GDV planned this year (two launched so far: Marina Vista and O2 High Street).
Management said it expects to add ₹2.5-3,000 crore GDV per ₹200 crore of capital, with ~₹3,000 crore of cash generation over three years.
capex_capacity: Aaradhya OnePark (Ghatkopar) delivery targeted by March 2027 with structure complete and finishing ongoing.
Aaradhya Avaan (Tardeo) half-building delivery targeted March 2028; 100% RCC targeted by August 2027.
Aaradhya Parkwood remaining two towers due by end of next year; Atmosphere Tower G due by December 2027.
Management said DM projects require under 10% of GDV as investment.
Construction is largely in-house (plant, machinery, labour camps), which management says speeds execution.
demand_pricing: Ultra-luxury ticket sizes are ₹1 lakh per sq ft and above; Mount Mary and Pali Hill sell around ₹20,000-25,000 per sq ft depending on inventory (as stated; figures in the transcript are inconsistent).
Management said its underwriting assumes zero price appreciation and a 10-15% discount to market, with a target of about 20% bottom-line margin.
Management cited raw-material inflation of 13-15% (marble, tiles, steel) linked to the Middle East conflict, which it expects to pass through in pricing.
Management said it will not expand outside MMR for the next couple of years, citing margin per sq ft and cyclical risk in other cities.
Management said Q1 pre-sales are lumpy because launches drive sales; it cited a ₹1,000 crore-plus presales month at launch and said Marine Lines and Berkeley House are not yet launched.
